title: Design System: Health Habit Hub Website

display.purpose: Page h1s, one per page. Largest Fraunces weight in the system.

body.purpose: Lead paragraphs and running copy, Figtree at 1.6 line-height.

label.purpose: Small uppercase tags above section headlines, rationed to roughly 1 per 2-3 sections.

shadows.name: ambient-card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for feature cards and figures (growth graph, habit cluster).

shadows.name: deep-card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for the largest showcase panels (admin portal screenshot).

shadows.name: brand-hover-glow-green
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus glow in the Living Leaf Green scope.

shadows.name: brand-hover-glow-orange
shadows.purpose: Hover/focus glow in the Research Ember (.rtheme) scope.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: Entrance reveals and hover lifts, the system's primary motion curve.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main CTA. Living Leaf Green fill; recolors to Research Ember automatically inside .rtheme scopes.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 11px 19px; border-radius: 13px; border: none; cursor: pointer; background: var(--living-leaf-action, #2e8c00); color: #fff; transition: transform .14s, background .2s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--living-leaf-deep, #256f00); box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(46,140,0,.34); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--living-leaf, #45b700); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary CTA, sits beside a primary button.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 11px 19px; border-radius: 13px; cursor: pointer; background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--ink, #0f172a); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2e8f0); transition: transform .14s, border-color .2s, color .2s; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover { border-color: var(--living-leaf, #45b700); color: var(--living-leaf-deep, #256f00); } .ds-btn-ghost:active { transform: scale(.97); } .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--living-leaf, #45b700); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.description: Ambient-shadow container used for figures, mockup tiles, and capability cards.
components.html:
Validierte Fragebögen

Anerkannte Instrumente wie der Self-Report Habit Index, automatisch über den Studienverlauf erhoben.
components.css: .ds-card { background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 20px; padding: 26px; box-shadow: 0 30px 60px -30px rgba(15,23,42,.24); transition: transform .3s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow .3s, border-color .3s; } .ds-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); border-color: var(--living-leaf, #45b700); box-shadow: 0 14px 34px rgba(46,140,0,.1); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Fraunces Variable', Georgia, serif; font-weight: 500; font-size: 18px; color: var(--ink, #0f172a); } .ds-card-body { color: var(--soft-slate, #64748b); font-size: 14.5px; margin-top: 8px; line-height: 1.6; }

components.name: Habit Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped example tag, the system's one full-pill component. Category-tinted, rotates slightly for an organic feel.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px 14px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--ink, #0f172a); background: rgba(37,111,0,.09); border: 1px solid transparent; cursor: default; transform: rotate(-1deg); transition: transform .22s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), border-color .22s, background .22s; } .ds-chip:hover, .ds-chip:focus-visible { border-color: var(--living-leaf-deep, #256f00); background: rgba(37,111,0,.18); transform: translateY(-2px) rotate(0deg); outline: none; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Contact-form field. Label above, accent-tinted focus ring, no placeholder-as-label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 7px; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; color: var(--ink, #0f172a); } .ds-input { font-family: inherit; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 400; color: var(--ink, #0f172a); background: var(--surface, #fff); border: 1px solid var(--hairline, #e2e8f0); border-radius: 11px; padding: 12px 14px; transition: border-color .16s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1), box-shadow .16s cubic-bezier(0.23,1,0.32,1); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--living-leaf, #45b700); box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(69,183,0,.12); }

components.name: App Store Badge
components.description: Two-line store badge (small caption over bold label). The 'coming soon' variant is visually muted and non-interactive.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 11px; padding: 10px 18px; border-radius: 13px; border: 1px solid transparent; text-decoration: none; transition: transform .14s, box-shadow .2s; } .ds-badge-text { display: flex; flex-direction: column; line-height: 1.15; } .ds-badge-text small { font-size: 10.5px; opacity: .8; } .ds-badge-text strong { font-size: 15px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-badge-ios { background: #0f172a; color: #fff; } .ds-badge-ios:hover { box-shadow: 0 8px 20px rgba(15,23,42,.28); } .ds-badge-ios:active { transform: scale(.97); }

narrative.overview: This site keeps an honest, dual-accounted book: green for what participants get, orange for what researchers get, structurally equal but never visually mixed. Most of the site runs on green, the resting default; the moment a visitor commits to the researcher path, an entire subtree remaps its accent to orange via a single .rtheme scope, and nothing else changes. It's the same typographic voice, the same cards, the same spacing, just re-tinted for the other side of the ledger. The overall register is calm and credible, never flashy: a serif display face (Fraunces) for headlines gives it editorial warmth without tipping into 'creative agency' theatrics, set against a plain-spoken sans (Figtree) for everything functional. Depth comes from large, softly blurred, ink-tinted shadows rather than borders or color blocking, and motion is restrained, entrance reveals and hover lifts, never loops or attention-grabbing loops. Confirmed rejections from prior iterations: hand-drawn illustration that reads as crude rather than considered (the participant/researcher profile mark was rebuilt for this reason), and abstract data-visualization filler (a flying-particle cluster) in place of real, readable content.
keyCharacteristics: Editorial serif display (Fraunces) over a plain sans body (Figtree)
One resting accent (green), one earned accent (orange), swapped by scope, never mixed on one surface
Flat surfaces at rest; depth only from soft ink-tinted shadow on cards, brand-tinted glow only on hover
Generous whitespace, large rounded corners (16-22px) on containers, full-pill only for compact interactive tags
Real, honest content: real screenshots, real legal copy, illustrative data clearly labeled as illustrative, zero em dashes anywhere in copy

rules.name: The Ledger Rule
rules.body: Green and orange never appear as competing accents in the same section. A component is either in the resting (green) world or has been scoped into .rtheme (orange) entirely; there is no per-element mixing.

rules.name: The One Serif Rule
rules.body: Fraunces is reserved for display-weight moments (h1/h2/h3 and the occasional large numeral). It never appears in body copy, labels, or UI chrome; Figtree carries all of that.

rules.name: The Single-Column Floor Rule
rules.body: Every multi-column layout in this system, regardless of its desktop shape, collapses to one column on narrow viewports. No layout is allowed to overflow horizontally; this was a real, shipped bug (the nav overflowed below ~480px) and is now a hard floor, not a suggestion.

rules.name: The Earned Shadow Rule
rules.body: A shadow's color is either neutral ink (resting state) or the active accent (hover/interaction state). It is never the opposite accent, and it is never pure black.

rules.name: The Pill-Is-For-Tags Rule
rules.body: Full-radius pill shapes are reserved for small, individual, categorical tags. Cards, panels, and buttons never go full-pill; that would blur the one visual cue that tells a visitor 'this is a compact, filterable unit' from 'this is a container.'

dos: Do keep green and orange scoped to entire subtrees (.rtheme), never mixed within one section.
Do use Fraunces only for display-weight headlines and large standalone numerals; everything else is Figtree.
Do tint shadows to ink-navy at rest and to the active brand accent on hover; never ship a pure-black or untinted shadow.
Do collapse every multi-column layout to a single column below its breakpoint, and verify it at a true narrow viewport, not just a resized desktop window.

Do label illustrative or example content as illustrative in the copy itself (see the growth graph's 'illustrative example' caption and the habit-cluster's 'not real entries' note); never present invented data as real.
Do write zero em dashes in any visible copy, in either language.
donts: Don't introduce a third accent color; the palette is Living Leaf Green, Research Ember, and neutrals, nothing else.
Don't go full-pill on anything larger than a compact tag; cards, panels, and buttons keep the 11-22px soft-radius family.
Don't hand-roll a decorative SVG illustration by default; the profile mark is a named, deliberate exception, not a precedent for more illustration.
Don't stack more than one small-caps 'eyebrow' label every 2-3 sections; it's a rationed device, not a default header pattern.
Don't add a fourth data-visualization attempt without direction from the product owner first; two prior illustrative-graph concepts were already rejected before the current one shipped.
